name: @temporal-architect/web-ui
description: Build-only package: the shared SSE browser entry for the local-HTTP visualizer hosts. Bundles @temporal-architect/visualizer into one self-contained HTML file (vite-plugin-singlefile) that BOTH the Go twf-view binary (go:embed) and the Node @temporal-architect/serve package serve at '/'. Never published — it is a packaging format, not a library. Sibling of packages/vscode-ui (same shell, postMessage transport) — distinguished by surface: web (SSE) vs editor.
